antagonists.rationale_text: Einstellung-effect undermines tradition-vs-innovation-balance by causing a currently held idea or strategy to block consideration of fresh alternatives, collapsing the balance toward tradition.
antagonists.source_quote: Einstellung (Mental Set): The psychological phenomenon where an idea or strategy currently held in mind (tradition/expertise) blocks the consideration of fresh thoughts, preventing creative breakthroughs.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical names Einstellung as blocking consideration of innovative alternatives when existing mental sets dominate
antagonists.activation_condition: When existing mental sets and expertise block consideration of innovative alternatives

structured_tensions.tension_text: Tradition-vs-innovation-balance conflicts with status-quo-bias when preference for the current state prevents needed adaptation.
structured_tensions.source_quote: tradition-vs-innovation-balance conflicts with status-quo-bias (status quo bias) when status Quo Bias emphasizes the preference for existing conditions, which can resist the innovative changes needed in the Tradition Vs Innovation Balance.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Tradition-vs-innovation-balance conflicts with commitment-bias when prior commitments harden into overreliance on old methods.
structured_tensions.source_quote: tradition-vs-innovation-balance conflicts with commitment-bias (commitment and consistency bias) when commitment and Consistency Bias can lead to an over-reliance on traditional methods, hindering the flexibility required for innovation.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Tradition-vs-innovation-balance conflicts with confirmation-bias when teams keep collecting support for tradition while ignoring evidence that the balance point should shift.
structured_tensions.source_quote: tradition-vs-innovation-balance conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when teams seek evidence that confirms the existing tradition while dismissing signals that the balance point needs to shift.
